articles.title: Two Sisters, One Piano Bench, and 55 Years of Musical Magic
articles.summary: Imagine playing piano so perfectly with your sister that a famous composer changed his mind! Katia and Marielle Labèque have been a piano duo for over 55 years. Their new 55-track album is full of surprises, including music by women composers they almost forgot.

articles.title: The Secret Superpower in Emily Blunt's New Movie? Comfy Sneakers!
articles.summary: In the alien thriller Disclosure Day, Emily Blunt's character Margaret wears fancy dresses for TV—but sneakers on her feet. Those white sneakers aren't just comfy; they show she's smart, practical, and ready to run when aliens arrive. Finally, a movie heroine with sensible shoes!
